subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do CI/security workflow owners approve these updated third-party action revisions for the credentialed dispatch, release, security-scanning, and automation workflows?
rationale: The patch changes trusted code executed with repository credentials and release/security privileges; source-level review alone cannot decide the repository's supplier-acceptance policy.

options.title: Approve after supplier review
options.body: Review the upstream action revisions and merge only after the refreshed exact head passes the required workflow gates.

options.title: Hold selected action upgrades
options.body: Split out any action whose release notes or workflow compatibility need further investigation and merge only the approved subset.

recommendation.title: Approve after supplier review
recommendation.body: Review the upstream action revisions and merge only after the refreshed exact head passes the required workflow gates.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the acceptance decision for action code executing in privileged repository workflows.
